name: Ponytail
summary: Hook-injected rules that push toward the simplest working change. Pinned to v5.3.3 (4.10.2 fixed a security issue), with a subagent matcher and a standing rule that keeps tests in the project's own framework.

evidence.setting: Opus 5.5, claude -p, CLI 2.1.288, 39 tasks x 5 runs x 3 arms, Bash disabled, CLAUDE.md loading and auto memory off
Ponytail 4.8.4, Claude Code 2.1.201, Sonnet 5 at medium effort, 80 paired tasks
evidence.effect: cost -10.3% (p = 0.004); not a test of v5
cost +0.7% [-6.5, +9.8] vs no add-on and +6.9% vs a one-sentence prompt asking for a runnable check

killTest.hypothesis: Ponytail 5.3.3 beats both no add-on and the one-line rule
killTest.pass: Wins against both, with Bash on, instruction files present and subagents allowed
killTest.budget: 40 tasks x 3 arms x 2 runs; 2 weeks
killTest.ifFails: Assess; existing users see the result with an offer to remove

egress.optional: a webhook, only if the user sets a URL

maintenance: Single maintainer, no private security channel; pinned to v5.3.3.
